      properties:

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          title: Schema validation errors

          items:

      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `ensureUniqueHousehold` step between the telephone check and customer-code assignment.

Each changed/new function has essentially no surrounding class complexity (single-method classes), and the one existing method touched (`BuildOwner.service`) stayed trivial.
